summary.text: Fue Lee is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 59A, where Ballotpedia lists the current tenure as beginning in 2017, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Ballotpedia lists no other candidate in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Lee's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Agriculture Finance and Policy Committee and the House Capital Investment Committee (as Co-Chair); in 2023-2024 he chaired the House Capital Investment Committee.
